mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h3_naver_statreport_daily (deltakey, daily_dt, report_type, success, jobid, userid) VALUES (#{deltakey}, #{daily_dt}, #{report_type}, #{success}, #{jobid}, #{userid})
mapper.select: SELECT k.kwid AS keywordId, c.campaignid AS campaignId, k.adgroupid AS adgroupId FROM h3_naver_keyword k LEFT JOIN h3_naver_adgroup g ON g.gid = k.adgroupid AND g.advkey = k.advkey LEFT JOIN h3_naver_campaign c ON c.campaignid = g.cid WHERE k.advkey = #{customerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h3_keyword_daily_naver_new ( daily_dt, user_id, daily_advid, campaign_id, adgroup_id, keyword_id, daily_im, daily_clk, daily_cst, daily_cv, daily_cr ) VALUES ( #{daily_dt}, NULL, #{daily_advid}, #{campaign_id}, #{adgroup_id}, #{keyword_id}, #{daily_im}, #{daily_clk}, #{daily_cst}, #{daily_cv}, #{daily_cr} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE campaign_id = VALUES(campaign_id), adgroup_id = VALUES(adgroup_id), daily_im = VALUES(daily_im), daily_clk = VALUES(daily_clk), daily_cst = VALUES(daily_cst), daily_cv = VALUES(daily_cv), daily_cr = VALUES(daily_cr), daily_regdate = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO h3_target_daily_naver ( daily_dt, daily_advid, campaign_id, adgroup_id, keyword_id, ad_id, bc_id, hours, rcode, mcode, pmtype, daily_im, daily_clk, daily_cst, daily_cv, daily_cr, sumofrank, cvmethod, cvtype ) VALUES
( #{r.daily_dt}, #{r.daily_advid}, #{r.campaign_id}, #{r.adgroup_id}, #{r.keyword_id}, #{r.ad_id}, #{r.bc_id}, #{r.hours}, #{r.rcode}, #{r.mcode}, #{r.pmtype}, #{r.daily_im}, #{r.daily_clk}, #{r.daily_cst}, #{r.daily_cv}, #{r.daily_cr}, #{r.sumofrank}, #{r.cvmethod}, #{r.cvtype} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE daily_im = VALUES(daily_im), daily_clk = VALUES(daily_clk), daily_cst = VALUES(daily_cst), daily_cv = VALUES(daily_cv), daily_cr = VALUES(daily_cr), sumofrank = VALUES(sumofrank), daily_regdate = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
